# Settings keys

Every setting the app stores, one JSON value per key in the database's `settings` table, with its default. A missing or invalid value reads as the default. The Settings page saves them; `finance settings --json` prints the ones marked *shown* (never a key, password or whole identity); the *internal* ones are used by the app itself (`access.*` is printed there in a summarized form). See [Settings](../settings.md) for what each one does.

| Key | Default | Shown |
|---|---|---|
| `sync.daily_time` | `"06:30"` | shown |
| `sync.weekly_day` | `"sun"` | shown |
| `sync.weekly_time` | `"18:00"` | shown |
| `alerts.cap_80` | `true` | shown |
| `alerts.over_cap` | `true` | shown |
| `alerts.broken_connection` | `true` | shown |
| `alerts.destination` | `"Hermes chat"` | shown |
| `ai.mode` | `"hermes"` | shown |
| `ai.preset` | `"openrouter"` | shown |
| `ai.base_url` | `"https://openrouter.ai/api/v1"` | shown |
| `ai.model` | `""` | shown |
| `ai.monthly_cap` | `5.0` | shown |
| `ai.min_confidence` | `0.7` | shown |
| `mcp.enabled` | `true` | shown |
| `mcp.allow_writes` | `false` | internal |
| `valuations.carfax` | `true` | shown |
| `valuations.redfin` | `true` | shown |
| `valuations.photos` | `true` | shown |
| `region.currency` | `"USD"` | shown |
| `region.locale` | `"en-US"` | shown |
| `region.week_start` | `"sun"` | shown |
| `region.budget_month_start` | `1` | shown |
| `appearance.theme` | `"dark"` | shown |
| `access.mode` | `null` | internal |
| `access.proxy_header` | `"Tailscale-User-Login"` | internal |
| `access.allowed_identities` | `[]` | internal |
| `access.public_urls` | `[]` | internal |
| `access.last_proxy` | `null` | internal |
| `setup.done` | `false` | internal |
| `plaid.demo` | `false` | internal |
| `plaid.plan` | `"trial"` | internal |
| `plaid.on_demand_refresh` | `null` | internal |

`valuations.*`: the default above is only what an unsaved key reads as. What is in effect comes from `config.free_sources()`: a flag in the env file, else the switch saved on the Settings page, else a new install's default (see [Valuation sources](#valuation-sources)). `finance settings` prints that.

## Region

Currencies (display only: amounts are never converted): `USD`, `EUR`, `GBP`, `CAD`, `AUD`, `NZD`, `CHF`, `JPY`, `SEK`, `NOK`, `DKK`, `PLN`, `CZK`, `MXN`, `BRL`, `INR`, `SGD`, `HKD`, `ZAR`, `ILS`, `KRW`, `TRY`, `UAH`.

Locales: `en-US`, `en-GB`, `en-CA`, `en-AU`, `en-IN`, `de-DE`, `fr-FR`, `es-ES`, `es-MX`, `it-IT`, `nl-NL`, `pt-BR`, `pl-PL`, `sv-SE`, `ja-JP`, `uk-UA`.

## Valuation sources

Keyless public sources for car and home values and pictures. A source's calls are counted before they are sent, failed ones too, and it stops for the month at its cap.

| Provider | Calls per month (cap) | Block after a refusal (days) |
|---|---|---|
| `nhtsa` | 300 | rest of the month |
| `carfax` | 6 | 7 |
| `redfin` | 20 | 7 |
| `commons` | 60 | 1 |
| `osm` | 20 | 7 |

On / off switches: the Settings page (Valuations), or a flag in the env file, which wins: `CARFAX_ENABLED=0`, `REDFIN_ENABLED=0`, `PHOTOS_ENABLED=0`. A new install starts with carfax off, redfin off, photos on.
